clue.text: Suppress record

definitions.meaning: to crush or quell a rebellion, say
to write something down on paper

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit the phrase: crushing a revolt and noting an entry in writing.

clue.text: Interrogate relatives in bed

parts.note: to pump someone is to question them persistently for information
kin are one's family members

explanation.surface: Someone is grilling their family members while they lie in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in bed' looks like part of the picture of an interrogation, but it is the definition: a vegetable growing in a garden bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A gourd vegetable grown in a garden plot, so it is found in a vegetable bed.

clue.text: Scottish began re-organising their national pastime

indicators.note: reorganising means the letters of the preceding words are arranged afresh

parts.note: the short word re is part of the fodder, taken as written

explanation.surface: Scots are said to have started reshaping their favourite traditional sport.
explanation.walkthrough: 're-organising' shuffles SCOTTISH, BEGAN and RE together; 'their' refers back to the Scots, giving a fair definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Hurling a long wooden pole is a famous Highland Games event, a traditional Scottish sport.

clue.text: Don't include a birthday honour with it

parts.note: the OM, Order of Merit, is a British honour that can appear in the monarch's Birthday Honours list

explanation.surface: Someone advises leaving out a royal award when listing things.
explanation.walkthrough: The Birthday Honours is the British list of awards announced on the monarch's official birthday; OM is the Order of Merit.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave something out is simply a synonym of excluding it.

clue.text: Denied gun was used in necessity

indicators.note: the gun is placed inside the word for necessity, as if being put to use in it

parts.note: need is a synonym of necessity
gat is old slang for a gun or pistol

explanation.surface: Someone was refused permission even though a firearm had to be used out of need.
explanation.walkthrough: 'was used in' reads like part of the story of a weapon, but it is the container signal; GAT is old American gangster slang for a pistol.
explanation.definitionFit: To deny something is to nullify or contradict it, the sense of cancelled out.

clue.text: Post requiring services of a high-flier

definitions.text: Post requiring services of a high-flier

parts.words: Post requiring services of a high-flier
parts.note: letters that travel by aeroplane need someone who flies high, a pilot, to carry them

explanation.surface: A job vacancy that needs the skills of an ambitious high achiever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Post' suggests a job and 'high-flier' an ambitious person; in fact the post is mail and the high-flier an aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: Mail carried by aircraft depends on aviators to deliver it.

clue.text: A sound shanty in Ghana

indicators.note: the word sound tells us to take the way shanty is pronounced, not its spelling

parts.note: said aloud, these words sound like SHANTI

explanation.surface: A sailors' song with a good ring to it is heard in a West African country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like an adjective meaning healthy, but it signals the homophone of SHANTY, written SHANTI.
explanation.definitionFit: The region around Kumasi, home of a historic kingdom, lies within that West African country.

clue.text: Wholly engrossed with a new part

indicators.note: new means the letters of the following word are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: An actor is utterly absorbed in a fresh role.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges PART.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone completely absorbed is enthralled, the meaning of the adjective.

clue.text: Cinema art, and too contrived!

indicators.note: something contrived is artificially put together, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A complaint that a type of film is too artificial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contrived' rearranges CINEMA ART AND TOO; the whole clue also describes the answer, a film art form that is deliberately constructed.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawn film is a form of cinema art built frame by frame, so it is contrived by nature.

clue.text: Hooked on security precaution

definitions.meaning: fastened by a hook or catch
a door secured by a catch is said to be on the catch

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: caught hold of something, and a door fastened with a small catch for safety.

clue.text: Failing to understand what is wrong with a blunt needle

definitions.meaning: not grasping what matters in an argument

definitions.text: what is wrong with a blunt needle
definitions.meaning: literally, a blunt needle lacks its sharp tip

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means not grasping the key idea, and a blunt needle literally lacks its sharp tip.

clue.text: King to get ill from cabbage

parts.note: K is the abbreviation for king in chess and cards
to ail is to be unwell

explanation.surface: A monarch falls sick after eating some greens.
explanation.walkthrough: KAIL is a variant spelling of kale, a leafy cabbage.
explanation.definitionFit: Kale is a leafy variety of the brassica family.

clue.text: How reconciled friends should be when they make amends

definitions.meaning: in harmony or agreement, as a two-word phrase
to make up for a wrong, read as one word

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it means in harmony; as one word it means to make up for a wrong.

clue.text: Where John lost his crown in the laundry tub

definitions.meaning: King John is said to have lost the crown jewels crossing the estuary bay of eastern England
clothes waiting to be cleaned, or the cleaning itself

explanation.walkthrough: The Wash is a large bay on England's east coast where, legend says, King John's baggage train and jewels were lost in 1216.
explanation.definitionFit: The East Anglian bay of the legend shares its name with clothes being laundered.

clue.text: Five hundred join together to embrace

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for five hundred
to ally is to unite with another

explanation.surface: A large crowd links arms in a hug.
explanation.walkthrough: To dally is to toy amorously with someone, which is how 'embrace' defines it.
explanation.definitionFit: Flirting or caressing lightly is the old amorous sense of the verb.

clue.text: The question to be settled when apportioning inheritance

definitions.meaning: a point in dispute that needs resolving
offspring, the children who matter when an estate is divided

explanation.definitionFit: It means a disputed point, and also children or descendants who share an estate.

clue.text: One who is endlessly dragging up excuses for parsimony

definitions.text: One who is endlessly dragging up excuses for parsimony

indicators.note: in a down-style reading, up means the letters are read backwards
endlessly means the final letter of the word is cut off

explanation.surface: A miser who keeps coming up with justifications for meanness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts the last G from DRAGGING to give DRAGGIN, and 'up' turns that backwards; the whole clue also pictures a skinflint making excuses.
explanation.definitionFit: A miserly person always ready with reasons for being stingy.

clue.text: Detains wrongfully as a substitute for another

indicators.note: wrongfully suggests the word is handled improperly, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is held unlawfully in place of another person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrongfully' rearranges DETAINS.
explanation.definitionFit: Meaning in place of, the adverb names a replacement for something else.

clue.text: School lacking nothing but a basic subject and someone to learn it

indicators.note: lacking means the letter for nothing is taken away from the word school

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
R stands for one of the three Rs, reading, writing and arithmetic, the basics of education

explanation.surface: A school with nothing but one elementary subject and a pupil to study it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'School lacking nothing' is SCHOOL without one O; 'but' and 'and' are joining words.
explanation.definitionFit: A learned person or pupil is one who studies.

clue.text: Denounced for having spent the housekeeping money

definitions.meaning: British slang for informed on to the police

definitions.text: for having spent the housekeeping money
definitions.meaning: went to the stores and bought groceries

explanation.walkthrough: To shop someone is British slang for reporting them to the police.
explanation.definitionFit: It means informed on, in British slang, and also went buying household goods.

clue.text: Regret giving signal corps code to sappers

indicators.note: to here means attached to, so the code comes after the sappers

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, are the British army's sappers
Morse is the dot-and-dash code used by army signallers

explanation.surface: Sorrow at handing a military signalling code to army engineers.
explanation.walkthrough: Sappers are military engineers; in the British army they belong to the Royal Engineers, RE.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep sorrow or contrition for something done is a synonym of regret.

clue.text: Starting course swindle is a very little thing

parts.note: soup is often served as the first course of a meal
a con is a swindle

explanation.surface: A diner complains the first course was a rip-off, barely anything on the plate.
explanation.walkthrough: SOUPCON is the French word for a tiny amount, a hint or trace.
explanation.definitionFit: A trace or tiny amount, borrowed from French.

clue.text: Polish bombard Air Corps

parts.note: to shell is to bombard with artillery

explanation.surface: Polish forces attack an air unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' tempts as the nationality, but it is the varnish.
explanation.definitionFit: A resin varnish used to finish wood, so a kind of polish.

clue.text: Long-term deserts of sin seem in order

indicators.note: putting letters in order means arranging them, so these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Sinners eventually get what they deserve, it seems, once everything is set right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in order' rearranges SIN SEEM; 'of' is a joining word.
explanation.definitionFit: Inescapable retribution, the just deserts that finally catch up with someone.

clue.text: How many times must one be divided by a hundred to get.01?

definitions.text: How many times must one be divided by a hundred to get.01?

indicators.note: a word divided by another is split open with the other placed inside it

parts.note: taken as written
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: An arithmetic question: how often must you divide unity by a hundred to reach a hundredth?
explanation.walkthrough: 'be divided by' splits ONE around C; the sum also works, since a single division of one by a hundred gives .01.
explanation.definitionFit: A single occasion, one time, answers the arithmetic question.

clue.text: One politician the Spanish thrust forward

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
an MP is a Member of Parliament
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A lone politician pushes Spain onward.
explanation.walkthrough: MP is Member of Parliament, a British legislator.
explanation.definitionFit: To drive or urge onwards is a synonym of propel.

clue.text: A snifter the doctor needs the morning after

indicators.note: after places the morning abbreviation behind the doctor's

parts.note: Dr abbreviates doctor
a.m. stands for ante meridiem, the morning

explanation.surface: A medic needs a stiff drink the morning after a heavy night.
explanation.walkthrough: A snifter is a small alcoholic drink, as is a dram of whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: A small measure of spirits, a nip, is a snifter.

clue.text: Bring one's name to notice

definitions.meaning: to write one's signature on a document
a posted board or placard giving information

explanation.definitionFit: It means putting a signature to a paper, and also a posted placard.

clue.text: An attempt to raise bats

indicators.note: in a down entry, raising a word lifts it so it reads from the bottom upward

explanation.surface: Someone tries to breed flying mammals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to raise' turns BATS upward.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a go at something is having a try, the informal sense.

clue.text: Prominent members of the family helping to create the right image

definitions.meaning: read literally, kinsfolk who are well known

definitions.text: helping to create the right image
definitions.meaning: the business of managing reputation and publicity

explanation.definitionFit: Read literally it is well-known kin; as a phrase it is the trade of managing reputation.

clue.text: Ran in the Fascist leader for imprisonment

indicators.note: in puts the first word inside the title of the Italian dictator

parts.note: Il Duce was Mussolini's title as Fascist leader of Italy

explanation.surface: Someone ran into the dictator and was locked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ran' looks like the verb of the sentence, but it is fodder placed by 'in'; Il Duce, 'the leader', was Mussolini's title.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic word for confinement or captivity.

clue.text: A ban in Central America and the South elicits beach tents

indicators.note: in places the phrase a ban inside the abbreviation for Central America

parts.note: CA abbreviates Central America
taken as written
S is the abbreviation for south

explanation.surface: A prohibition across Central and South America draws out beach shelters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is the container signal; 'and' and 'elicits' are joining words. Cabanas are hut-like shelters on a beach.
explanation.definitionFit: Small cabins or shelters on a beach used for changing.
